_comment: Kiro MCP config for the Governed Agentic Companion cloud front door via the AGENTCORE GATEWAY. This is the ALTERNATIVE to the local-bridge config (onboarding/companion-kiro-mcp.example.json): instead of spawning frontdoor/mcp_bridge.py locally, Kiro connects directly to the JWT-authorized AgentCore Gateway that fronts the MCP runtime (agentcore/app/mcp_runtime). Use this once the Gateway is stood up. Copy the companion-engine entry into .kiro/settings/mcp.json and MERGE with existing mcpServers. GAC_GATEWAY_URL is the gateway's /mcp URL (https://<gateway-id>.gateway.bedrock-agentcore.<region>.amazonaws.com/mcp). The gateway namespaces tools by its target name 'gac', so the tools surface as gac___ask_companion / gac___companion_kb (see autoApprove). TIP: for the Kiro native-OAuth/PKCE path, replace the headers block with an oauth block (clientId = the cognito_oauth_frontdoor_client_id output, redirectUri http://127.0.0.1:8080, oauthScopes [openid, gac-engine/invoke]) so Kiro mints + auto-refreshes the token — see docs/FRONT-DOORS.md. Set ${GAC_GATEWAY_URL}/${GAC_GATEWAY_TOKEN} from your gitignored env — never commit a real URL or token. Keep the local-bridge config as the offline / gateway-down FALLBACK. Governance unchanged: the runtime response is already gated in the cloud; a human deploys (Tenet 1).
